input.reasoning_summary: Requester received an unsolicited email urging immediate password reset via an embedded link, a classic phishing pattern rather than a routine password expiry request.

summary.reported: Requester says they got an email claiming their password expires today, urging them to reset it using a link in that email, and asks IT to reset their password.
summary.checked: Reviewed the ticket description; no KB lookup was appropriate since this matches the pattern of an unsolicited urgent password-reset email with an embedded link.
summary.ruled_out: Did not treat this as a routine password expiry/reset request, since an unexpected email pushing a reset link is a classic phishing indicator.
summary.why_escalating: This looks like a phishing attempt; Security Team needs to verify the email's legitimacy, check for a wider phishing campaign, and handle any password reset through verified channels rather than the link the requester received.
